result.summary: The pedestrian environment includes a signalized intersection with a marked crosswalk and sidewalks, though the presence of streetcar tracks and faded markings introduces risks. Mature trees provide a pleasant buffer, but the degraded pavement near the tracks requires maintenance to ensure safe passage.

hazards.name: Streetcar tracks
hazards.description: Tracks embedded in the roadway can be a trip hazard for pedestrians or cause slips, especially when wet.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra markings are significantly worn, reducing visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven surfaces near the tracks and crosswalk area.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pavement repair
interventions.description: Resurface the area around the streetcar tracks to eliminate trip hazards and uneven footing.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features a signalized crossing with marked crosswalks, but the infrastructure is aged and lacks dedicated pedestrian signals. The surrounding environment is heavily wooded with narrow, potentially obstructed sidewalks and degraded pavement surfaces.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are worn and faded, reducing visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The roadway and crossing area show significant cracking and wear, creating potential trip hazards.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with continental or ladder-style high-visibility markings.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve crossing safety and predictability.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearing
interventions.description: Repair the sidewalk surface and clear vegetation/obstructions to ensure a continuous, accessible path.

result.summary: The intersection features basic traffic control with overhead signals but lacks dedicated pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. The roadway surface is in poor condition with a mix of asphalt and cobblestones, creating potential trip hazards and uneven walking surfaces.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to designate a safe crossing path for pedestrians at this signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Degraded and uneven pavement
hazards.description: The roadway surface is a mix of cracked asphalt and cobblestones, creating significant trip hazards for anyone crossing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style painted crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection to provide a smooth, level walking surface across the entire crossing area.

result.summary: The intersection features marked crosswalks and a large pedestrian refuge island, providing some protection for people crossing. However, the wide turning radii and complex geometry may encourage higher vehicle speeds, and the uneven pavement transitions could pose challenges for pedestrians with mobility aids.

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The geometry of the right turn creates a slip-lane effect, which can lead to high vehicle speeds through the pedestrian crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection where the silver car is positioned.

hazards.name: Uneven pavement
hazards.description: The transition between cobblestones and asphalt, along with visible cracking, creates a potential trip hazard and accessibility barrier.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground pedestrian refuge area and crossing approach.

interventions.title: Curb Radius Reduction
interventions.description: Tighten the curb radii to slow down vehicles making right turns and reduce the pedestrian crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the standard parallel line markings to continental or ladder style markings to increase visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Pavement Leveling and Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the pedestrian refuge area to provide a smooth, level surface for all users, including those with mobility devices.
